name: RDX Auto Filter
description: RDX-branded Telegram auto-filter bot with indexed search, thumbnail-preserving file delivery, streaming and premium access.

CHANNELS.description: Username or ID of channel or group. Separate multiple IDs by space.

ADMINS.description: Username or ID of Admin. Separate multiple Admins by space.

PICS.description: Private /start poster. Accepts a local asset path or HTTPS image URL; separate multiple images by spaces.

NOR_IMG.description: No-results poster path or HTTPS URL.

SPELL_IMG.description: Spell-check suggestion poster path or HTTPS URL.

FSUB_PICS.description: Force-subscription poster path or HTTPS URL.

SUBSCRIPTION.description: Premium-plan poster path or HTTPS URL.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Bot Logs,Give a channel id with -100xxxxxxx

AUTH_USERS.description:
Username or ID of users to give access of inline search. Separate multiple users by space.
Leave it empty if you don't want to restrict bot usage.

AUTH_CHANNEL.description: ID of channel.Make sure bot is admin in this channel. Without subscribing this channel users cannot use bot.

DATABASE_URI.description: mongoDB URI. Get this value from https://www.mongodb.com.

DATABASE_URI2.description: mongoDB URI. Get this value from https://www.mongodb.com.

DATABASE_NAME.description: Name of the database in mongoDB.

COLLECTION_NAME.description: Existing MongoDB collection name. Keep the old value when upgrading so indexed files remain available.

START_ANIMATION.description: Enable or disable the private /start loader animation.

START_ANIMATION_STYLE.description: Start loader design: cinema, neon, or minimal.

VERIFY.description: Require a quick verification before free users download files.

VERIFY_ACCESS_HOURS.description: Number of hours a successful verification remains active.

VERIFY_TOKEN_MINUTES.description: Number of minutes a new verification link remains valid.

VERIFY_NOTICE_DELETE_SECONDS.description: Seconds before the verification-required message is deleted.

VERIFY_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used when displaying verification expiry times.

VERIFY_POSTER.description: Verification-required poster path or HTTPS URL.

VERIFIED_POSTER.description: Successful-verification poster path or HTTPS URL.

HOW_TO_VERIFY.description: Tutorial video or channel link shown on verification screens.

DEENDAYAL_VERIFIED_LOG.description: Channel ID where successful verification logs are sent.

SHORTLINK_API.description: API key for the verification shortener.

ANTI_BYPASS_API_KEY.description: Same value as API_KEY in the RDX Anti-Bypass service.

ANTI_BYPASS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds to wait while creating a protected link.

SOURCE_CODE_LINK.description: Your repository URL. The original upstream source is used when left unchanged.
